name: Working at Heights
controls: Use scaffolding or EWP where possible
Install edge protection / guardrails
Use fall arrest harness when guardrails not practical
Secure tools and materials to prevent falling objects
Inspect ladders and scaffolding before use
Maintain 3 points of contact on ladders
Exclusion zone below work area

name: Demolition Work
controls: Check for asbestos before any demolition - engage licensed assessor if suspected
Isolate all services (power, gas, water) before work
Establish exclusion zone around demolition area
Demolish from top down
Use water spray to suppress dust
Shore up adjacent structures as needed
Remove debris regularly - do not allow accumulation

name: Excavation & Trenching
controls: Dial Before You Dig - obtain service plans
Hand dig within 500mm of known services
Shore or batter trenches deeper than 1.5m
Barricade open excavations
Keep spoil minimum 1m from trench edge
Provide safe entry/exit (ladder every 9m)
Spotter for all plant operations near excavation

name: Electrical Work (General)
controls: Only licensed electricians to perform electrical work
Isolate and tag out circuits before work
Test for dead before touching
Use insulated tools rated for voltage
RCD protection on all circuits
Do not work on live equipment unless absolutely necessary and risk assessed

name: Hot Works (Welding, Grinding, Cutting)
controls: Clear combustible materials from 10m radius
Fire extinguisher within 5m of work area
Fire watch for 30 minutes after hot works cease
Welding screens to protect others from UV
Adequate ventilation or extraction for fumes
Hot work permit if required by site

name: General Construction
controls: Maintain good housekeeping - clear walkways
Use mechanical aids for heavy lifting where possible
Team lift items over 20kg
Keep work area well lit
Secure loose materials and cables
Apply sunscreen, wear hat and long sleeves outdoors
First aid kit accessible on site at all times
